system.name: AEGIS
system.one_liner: an online two-stage silent-data-corruption detection system for large-scale LLM training that senses suspicious GPU computations then verifies them off the critical path

components.name: Burn-in Test
components.role: GPU lifecycle stage performed at the factory before deployment

components.name: Stress Tests
components.role: GPU lifecycle stage performed at data-center bring-up

components.name: Proactive Diagnostics
components.role: operational-stage fault check preceding online detection

components.name: Online SDC Detection
components.role: the operational stage AEGIS targets, highlighted as the paper's contribution

components.name: Post-failure Analytics
components.role: operational-stage analysis performed after a failure is detected

components.name: Corruption Sensor
components.role: performs lightweight in-situ sensing of protected computations on the critical path

components.name: Algorithmic Detection
components.role: one sensing strategy used by the Corruption Sensor

components.name: Deterministic Detection
components.role: another sensing strategy used by the Corruption Sensor

components.name: Different Sensors
components.role: placeholder for additional heterogeneous sensor types unified via the vTask abstraction

components.name: Op1
components.role: a protected computation on the per-GPU execution timeline instrumented by the Corruption Sensor

components.name: Op2
components.role: a protected computation later flagged as potentially corrupted

components.name: Op3
components.role: a protected computation on the per-GPU execution timeline

components.name: Op2(R)
components.role: a replay of Op2 executed later so cVerifier can check it against recorded evidence

components.name: vT
components.role: a verification task (vTask) executed on the GPU during a naturally occurring idle period

components.name: OpN
components.role: a later protected computation on the per-GPU execution timeline

components.name: vTasks Queue
components.role: holds verification tasks created by the Corruption Sensor until they are scheduled

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: dispatches vTasks to GPUs during idle periods for verification

components.name: Corruption Verifier
components.role: performs definitive confirmation of flagged computations off the critical path

components.name: Platform
components.role: receives confirmed SDC incident reports to enable restart and rollback

content.key_idea: AEGIS decouples a lightweight always-on sensor that flags suspicious GPU computations from a heavier verifier that confirms them off the critical path during idle GPU time.

summary: AEGIS is a two-stage online silent-data-corruption (SDC) detection system for large-scale LLM training. The figure has two connected parts: a compact lifecycle timeline spanning Factory, Data Center Bring-up, and Data Center Operation (Burn-in Test, Stress Tests, Proactive Diagnostics, Post-failure Analytics), with the 'Online SDC Detection' stage highlighted in red and linked by a shaded wedge to a detailed architecture box below. That box shows a per-GPU execution timeline of operations (Op1...OpN) instrumented by a lightweight Corruption Sensor, which records evidence after each computation and, when suspicious, creates a vTask (step 3) placed in a queue; a scheduler dispatches vTasks to idle GPU periods (step 4) where the Corruption Verifier compares fingerprints or replays the computation (step 5) and reports confirmed corruptions to the Platform (step 6) for rollback.
